integrity: The algebraic reduction uses previously published qualitative regularity criteria as background, while the exact comparable-image count and sharp occupancy correction are the assessed finding. Numerical verification is corroborating only. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two labeled blocks of equal positive size only. Aperiodic local limit gives an asymptotic rather than an exact closed form for the limiting correction. The comparison with older probability literature is not exhaustive.
title: Sharp regular-element density for balanced two-block transformation monoids
